description: This file defines the CustomersController class for the CustomerManagement API, handling customer-related HTTP requests such as listing, retrieving by ID, creating, updating, and deleting customers. It mediates between HTTP endpoints and application commands and queries.

classes.name: CustomersController
classes.description: Controller class managing customer-related HTTP requests, utilizing dependency-injected IMediator to perform application layer commands and queries.

methods.name: GetCustomers
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list customers with pagination and optional search filter.

methods.name: GetCustomerById
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a customer by GUID ID.

methods.name: CreateCustomer
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new customer with data from the request body.

methods.name: UpdateCustomer
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to update an existing customer identified by GUID ID.

methods.name: DeleteCustomer
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to remove a customer by GUID ID.
